guna.note: Fresh and simple — the sattvic default for plant food eaten close to how it grew.

effects.note: A cup or so of blueberries, fresh or freeze-dried, has improved memory within a few hours of eating them in several controlled trials in both children and adults, with some trials also showing gains in attention and executive function — a pattern a 2019 systematic review backs across independent studies. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
